name: fastly
title: Fastly
description: Access your Fastly account from Raycast
author: JonathanSpeek

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Fastly API Token
preferences.description: Your Fastly API token from https://manage.fastly.com/account/tokens

commands.name: index
commands.title: Manage Services
commands.description: View and manage your Fastly services

commands.name: invite
commands.title: Invite Team Member
commands.description: Invite a new member to your Fastly team

commands.name: create-service
commands.title: Create Service
commands.description: Create a new Fastly service

commands.name: purge
commands.title: Purge Cache
commands.description: Purge a URL, surrogate keys, or everything on a service, with optional soft purge

commands.name: realtime
commands.title: Watch Real-Time Stats
commands.description: Watch live requests, hit ratio, errors, and bandwidth for a service

commands.name: service-addons
commands.title: Manage Service Add-Ons
commands.description: Enable or disable products like Image Optimizer, Fanout, and WebSockets per service

commands.name: tls
commands.title: Manage TLS Certificates
commands.description: View TLS certificates and subscriptions with expiry warnings

commands.name: alerts
commands.title: View Alerts
commands.description: View Fastly alert definitions and firing history

commands.name: kv-stores
commands.title: Manage KV Stores
commands.description: Browse and manage Fastly KV Store key-value pairs

commands.name: secret-stores

commands.description: View and manage Fastly Secret Store secrets

commands.name: config-stores
commands.title: Manage Config Stores
commands.description: View and manage Fastly Config Store key-value pairs

commands.name: acls
commands.title: Manage ACLs
commands.description: View and manage Fastly Access Control Lists and IP entries

commands.name: audit-log
commands.title: View Audit Log
commands.description: View and filter Fastly audit log events for security monitoring and compliance

commands.name: bot-management
commands.title: Manage Bot Management
commands.description: Enable Bot Management on services and view detected bot traffic

commands.name: ddos-protection
commands.title: Manage DDoS Protection

commands.name: ai-virtual-keys

commands.name: ai-providers
commands.title: Manage AI Runtime Control Providers
commands.description: Configure AI Runtime Control provider connections

commands.name: ai-usage
commands.title: View AI Runtime Control Usage
commands.description: View AI Runtime Control usage metrics by provider and model

commands.name: ai-sessions

commands.description: Browse AI Runtime Control session logs with request and response data

commands.name: docs
commands.title: Fastly Docs
commands.description: Helpful Fastly documentation

commands.name: support
commands.title: Get Support
commands.description: Access Fastly support resources

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
